==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. The Village King and I share theories on the Reality Warping Stone. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Village King resembles a giant, wooden, elf man who wears a green robe with a white fur collar.) (The Reality Warping Stone resembles a jagged diamond that is half pink and half yellow.)
We realize that the stone and the Death Staff are pieces of The Endless. (The Death Staff resembles a wooden staff that radiates with purple energy.) (The Endless is a demonic treefolk with an aura of glowing purple energy.)
More importantly we realize that The Endless isn't a single demon and is instead a race of all-powerful demon elementals. (The theory that Village King and I came up with is that the Golem Princess is one of the Endless and that the Endless are a species rather than the name of a single demon.) (The Golem Princess resembled a bald, golem woman with an hourglass figure. Her upper body was made of pink crystals, her lower body was made of yellow crystals, and she wore a long sparkling golden veil.)
